purpose: Final bounded M1 injected-assembly-deficit decision; no physical copy-number inference
mapping_rule: Frozen M1 ordinary_segments: nonoverlapping 80-bp cyclic-Hamming windows, 18 mismatch gate, ties abstain; assigned read bp divided by observed total-read-bp/source-genome-bp depth
candidate_rule: Frozen M1 full_read_research FullReadConfig defaults; assigned read bp divided by the same observed depth; ambiguous/unknown bp are not redistributed
production_rule: Current quantify_toy_copy_number k21 Python backend; source genome size is supplied; no external haploid depth; no quality correction on exact FASTA
span_rule: For each source array, require exact occurrence in one raw read of 32-bp immediate left and right flanks in either strand, in correct order; read interior bp between anchors; require >=3 distinct reads; median spans. Truth coordinates may locate source anchors but must not supply observed read spans. No fallback to simulator read-start ledger.
endpoint: For each family and each edited assembly: read-side estimated genomic repeat bp minus exact edited-assembly repeat bp; injected missing bp equals source repeat bp minus edited-assembly repeat bp. Keep signed values and do not clip.
interpretation: With fixed reads, a constant read estimate minus edited assembly bp is monotone with slope one by construction; monotonicity and difference of deficits relative to intact cannot validate absolute calibration or severity ranking.
a_gate: At both 20x and 30x, in every source seed and both unit-divergence settings, each identifiable family must have intact baseline absolute error <=10% of its source repeat bp and maximum absolute error over all edits <=20% of source repeat bp; no NA, silent zero or unreported ambiguous-family result qualifies.
b_gate: Requires independent severity discrimination when read-side source abundance changes across independently generated sources, with calibration and family stability; fixed-read assembly edits alone cannot pass this gate.
level_policy: If A fails and B is unsupported, retire calibrated and ordinal quantitative missing-bp claims (Level C scope only). Level C does not itself validate a binary detector; that requires a separate controlled structural truth and independent materials.
limitations: exact sequencing and exact 32-bp anchor matching
known planted catalogue and source genome size
three seeds are not independent biological donors
family-wide bp and single-locus span are comparable here only because each family has one array
